blocks.text: Postmortem: weekend double-charge on pickup prepaid

This is the working cut for LSH-INC-2025-024 on April 10, 2025. Mara Singh asked for a written bound after the current path (Woo capture cron plus POS capture on pickup scan, no shared key) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Luis Ortega, Cole Brennan, and Mara Singh. Primary host woo-prod.lakeshore.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on blame the processor and retry captures, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Idempotency key is order_id plus tender intent, not filename, not click time. Weekend plus Monday both ran a capture job. Lock the job. Refund the 11. Do not 'retry capture' from a laptop. I am not restating a hallway yes. blame the processor and retry captures is out because Retries without a key made 3 of the 11 into triples before Mara stopped the job at 09:12 Monday. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at orders=11, triples=3, stop=09:12, weekend=April 5, amount=1,284.60, weeks=1, jobs=2, key=1. Sibling tickets LSH-4718 and LSH-PRD-2025-007. I will not reopen blame the processor and retry captures in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Cole Brennan is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Mara Singh owns a leftover that is easy to skip: pickup.lakeshore.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (46): refuse on blame the processor and retry captures, lock is shared idempotency key, one capture path, laptop retry out. I will not hide a product change inside a 'quick align' on LSH-4718.
Refunds are not a root cause. Idempotency is. I will not brief a weekend as 'processor flakiness.'

What a skeptical user would try first on woo-prod.lakeshore.internal: the path Mara Singh actually has, not a desktop demo. Metric I will argue is time-to-useful, not a vanity QPS. If we cannot show that path on pos-01.lakeshore.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Michael Gilfilian will not accept a laptop screenshot as that proof.
